course: University of Auckland International School Leaver Scholarship
scholarshipDetail: Up to $20,000 toward compulsory tuition fees for new international students who have attended a New Zealand secondary school or kura, enrolling in first year of an undergraduate degree.

course: University of Auckland ASEAN High Achievers Scholarship
scholarshipDetail: Up to $10,000 towards tuition fees for new international students from ASEAN countries enrolling in undergraduate degrees, masters degrees or postgraduate diplomas.

course: University of Auckland India High Achievers Scholarship
scholarshipDetail: Up to $20,000 towards tuition fees for new international students from India enrolling full-time in undergraduate degrees, PGDip or masters degrees.

course: University of Auckland International Student Excellence Scholarship
scholarshipDetail: Up to $10,000 towards compulsory tuition fees for new international undergraduate and postgraduate students.

course: University of Auckland Malaysian Accommodation Award
scholarshipDetail: $5,000 Award to assist an international student from Malaysia with the costs of accommodation in a University of Auckland Hall of Residence.

course: University of Auckland Foundation Pathway High Achiever Award
scholarshipDetail: Up to $20,000 towards compulsory tuition fees for high achievers from Foundation Pathway partners enrolling in first semester of study.

course: University of Auckland Pathway Partner High Achiever Award
scholarshipDetail: Up to $10,000 towards tuition fees for international students from Pathway Partner NCUK enrolling in first year of an undergraduate degree.

course: University of Auckland ELA High Achiever Award
scholarshipDetail: $5000 for ELA FCert EAP students who wish to enrol in undergraduate studies at the University of Auckland.

course: University of Auckland Summer Research Scholarships
scholarshipDetail: Research experience opportunity. Open to high-achieving international students who have completed at least two years of an undergraduate degree by December 2024. Applications for 2025-2026 closed; next round mid-2026.

course: Chew Liong Kim & Tan Chee Chin Scholarship
scholarshipDetail: $8,000 Scholarship for domestic or international student enrolling in second or subsequent year of undergraduate degree, who has achieved academically but experiencing hardships or disadvantage.
Up to $8,000 to support domestic and international students with disabilities.
$5,000 Scholarship to support an international or domestic Bachelor of Design student with a passion for design who wants to be a game-changer in the field.

course: University of Auckland Colombo Plan Scholarship in Engineering
scholarshipDetail: $3,000 contribution towards undergraduate or postgraduate tuition fees in Engineering for an international student who is a citizen of a Colombo Plan member country.

course: University of Auckland Business School Asia Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarshipDetail: Covers tuition fees for up to 360 points of study. For international undergraduate students from Asia enrolling first time in first year of BCom, BProp, or associated conjoint degree in Business School.
$5,000 Scholarship for international and domestic students enrolled in undergraduate or postgraduate study in Faculty of Science relating to Cybersecurity.
Up to $4,500 for the final year of undergraduate study in Computer Science, Information and Technology Management, Information Systems or Software Engineering. Open to international students.
$6,000 Scholarship to support an international or domestic student enrolled full-time in Part III of an LLB (Bachelor of Laws) who is experiencing financial hardship.
